name: Alpha Vantage
summary: Daily prices for TSX (.TRT), TSX Venture (.TRV), and US listings with the user's own API key. Public market data only; no user account data.
revocation_path: Request a new key at https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key to retire the old one; `heiwa connect alpha-vantage --disconnect` removes the local copy.

source_notes.title: Alpha Vantage API documentation (TIME_SERIES_DAILY, Toronto Stock Exchange symbols)

capabilities.description: Read the latest ~100 daily bars for a symbol (the free tier's compact window) into local price history.
capabilities.permission_notes: Any Alpha Vantage key. The free tier allows 25 requests a day; full history requires a premium key.
capabilities.rate_hint: Free tier: 25 requests/day. Heiwa spends at most 8 per sync and skips series fetched in the last 20 hours.
